name: dumbbell press squat (thighs)
description: A squat combined with an overhead press. The legs drive the movement while the shoulders finish the press.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
